ops.title: ccr-images lane handoff: images #13 #15 #14 #16 merged at c2cb568, final plugins.sh contracts
ops.body:
Replaces monorepo cc-notes note `08d9e9b`, which does not resolve in this clone. It recorded PR #5 before merge, the inventory schema, fingerprints, ready stamps, and pending core integration.

## Merged state

- The `ccr-images` lane is closed at main `c2cb568249b51f054c3bce57bd9da777f06223cb`; this checkout is detached there.
- Earlier context: `2d670ad` (#5) added inventory rendering, image commands, fingerprints, and ready stamps.
- Earlier context: `e929259` (#11) added GitHub branch registration and the auto-update hold.
- `40be400f` (#13): `pin_marketplace` and `verify_marketplace` compare `recorded_source`. Ref marketplaces register the fetched directory; private fetches use the stdin token. Branch marketplaces register `repo#branch`. `edit_settings` uses `umask 077`, a private `mktemp` sibling of `settings.json`, then `mv` (`images/plugins.sh:95`, `images/plugins.sh:110`, `images/plugins.sh:267`).
- `738bf75c` (#15): Claude status reads fail closed through `claude_json`, explicit `|| exit`, and a separate plugin-root capture before running a bin (`images/plugins.sh:30`).
- `7bf22f9a` (#14): `synckit_state` creates missing `state.json` with directory mode 0700 and file creation under `umask 077`. It requires exactly one document with identity `synckit-state-v1` and the pinned fingerprint before `configure.run` or services. `cookiesync install` remains after `start_services` (`images/plugins.sh:283`, `images/plugins.sh:388`).
- `c2cb5682` (#16): `captain_hook_build` uses `jq -sr` with `length == 1`; install compares its output, while `verify_captain_hook` checks the capture before comparison. Tests add exact exit-42 plugin-root assertions, second-document list cases, and a one-shot `install_plugin` read fault (`images/plugins.sh:245`; tests below).

## Claude reads and marketplace rules

- Marketplace list uses `recorded_source`; plugin list uses `healthy` and `install_plugin`; plugin roots use `plugin_root` and `verify_plugin_bin`. `claude_json` checks command status and requires exactly one JSON document with `jq -se 'length == 1'`. `plugin_root`, `healthy`, and `recorded_source` explicitly exit on failed capture; `verify_plugin_bin` captures the root before running it (`images/plugins.sh:30`, `images/plugins.sh:59`, `images/plugins.sh:110`, `images/plugins.sh:163`).
- `Inventory.Validate` delegates to `validatePython` and `validateClaude`: exactly one of a `ref` of 40 lowercase hex digits and `branch`; private marketplaces require refs because Claude clones branches itself. Marketplace uv tools require a ref and belong only in `python.user`. Plugin IDs are `name@marketplace` (`internal/images/inventory.go:193`, `internal/images/inventory.go:493`, `internal/images/inventory.go:511`).
- `branchName` restricts characters and rejects `..`, trailing dots, empty components, dot-prefixed components, and `.lock` suffixes (`internal/images/inventory.go:38`, `internal/images/inventory.go:694`).

## Auto-update hold

- The Claude Code 2.1.286 probe below records that `claude-plugins-official` rejects local sources, and `#<sha>` fails because cloning uses `git clone --branch`.
- Settings `extraKnownMarketplaces.<name>.autoUpdate` takes precedence over `known_marketplaces.json` and defaults. `marketplace add` writes the declaration without `autoUpdate`; `update` preserves it; `remove` deletes it. `list --json` omits it (probe, “Per-marketplace auto-update”).
- `pin_branch_marketplace` writes `held_declaration` through `edit_settings`: GitHub source, `ref` equal to the branch, `autoUpdate: false`. `verify_branch_marketplace` checks exact declaration equality with one-document `jq -se` (`images/plugins.sh:136`).

## Fingerprints

- At this head, `go run ./cmd/cc-remote images fingerprint --inventory examples/inventory.yaml --profile agents` returned tools `4c8c254ac479ddc6ffd5440d384362d6bd2799bb1718ef37cd6e2af968957c0a` and image `42e68f9e3d982894c97fa0ef9dfd88b84daeae37934a3b5d5ecbea68bc1b23c5`.
- `docs/tool-inventory.md:25` has current tools; its `a377d3ec…` image value is pre-existing stale documentation owned by root’s #12 refresh. Rendered `plugins.sh` contributes to tools fingerprints (`internal/images/render.go:93`); refresh the docs example in each PR changing it.

## Regression tests

In `internal/images/plugins_linux_test.go`, with starting lines:

- `TestPluginsRegisterMarketplacesByRefAndBranch` (374): reconciliation and private settings replacement.
- `TestPluginsHoldBranchMarketplaceAgainstAutoUpdate` (531): hold and re-enabled updates.
- `TestPluginsVerifyRegistrations` (586): changed branch, directory, or source type.
- `TestPluginsFailClosedOnMarketplaceReads` (640): exit 42, trailing garbage, second document.
- `TestPluginsFailClosedOnPluginReads` (670): the same plugin-list failures, plugin-root exit 42, one-shot install read failure.
- `TestPluginsVerifyCaptainHookBuild` (710): build verification, including malformed and multiple documents.
- `TestPluginsConfigureWritesSynckitStateBeforeServices` (764): state creation, validation, preservation, and configure/service/cookiesync ordering.

## Evidence and follow-up

- Probe: `/Users/yasyf/.local/state/orca-workspace/recovery-20260930/cc-remote-images-11-probe.md`, including the per-marketplace auto-update section. It records throwaway `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` use and unchanged real `~/.claude/settings.json` and `~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json`; paid-session background auto-update was not exercised.
- Under `~/.cache/ccr-images/`, owner cleanup remains: `probe.F7vfiE` (44M), `probe-https.NMIQJt` (22M), `probe-au.tQthrD` (32K). The probe records the repository-deletion guard blocking `rm -rf` on public clones.
- `plugins.sh` is Go `text/template` rendered to Bash (`internal/images/render.go:137`). Preserve macOS Bash 3.2 support: it lacks `inherit_errexit` and clears errexit inside `$(...)`; explicit exits replaced that option in `8ff58c9`, included in #15.
- Run macOS `go test ./...` with `bash` resolving to `/bin/bash`: `TestFakeProviderSatisfiesTheLifecycleContract` uses Bash resolved through PATH (`internal/workspace/contract_test.go:13`; `internal/images/host.go:68`).
- The Linux-only `plugins_linux_test.go` uses Python fake Claude with settings and auto-update, sh fake Git, and fake `sprite-env`/`cookiesync` (lines 15, 130, 144, 218). Run `go test ./internal/images` locally through `docker run golang:1.26` with jq and python3 installed and `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto`; `go.mod:3` requires Go >=1.26.5.
- Keep Claude probes in throwaway configs. No image builds or paid resources without the drive ledger. Root owns README and `docs/architecture.md`; images owns `docs/tool-inventory.md` notes.
